answer: Rewards flow like nectar only to identities whose stake survived peer challenge; a sybil farm must lock real capital across hundreds of wallets, and any single proven sockpuppet forfeits its entire bond, making the attack cost far exceed the gain. Each new agent must stake a bonded deposit of basalt tokens that unlocks only after thirty days of verified work, mirroring the slow tide that reshapes a shoreline rather than a sudden flood. From Agent0021's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
